description: GLITCH GOD — every glitch-art + analog-degradation technique in one shader (52 modules). A single GOD SEED hashes into a recipe picking which modules fire and how hard. Digital: chromatic aberration, pixel-sort, datamosh, 8x8 macroblock corruption, kaleido, sine warp, slice, sync tear, block-jump, jitter, mosaic, posterize, hue-rotate, channel swap, solarize, static, dither, ghost echo, sobel edges, strobe, HDR bloom. Analog (research-authentic): VHS color-under smear, head-switch tear, dropout, tracking roll, time-base wobble, generation loss, RF snow; NTSC dot-crawl, cross-color rainbow, PAL Hanover bars, ringing, interlace combing, shadow-mask scanlines, phosphor persistence, vertical-hold roll; RF ghosting, hum bars, herringbone, ignition sparkle; video-synth Rutt-Etra terrain, feedback tunnel, Sandin colorizer, Paik-Abe hue, wobbulator, chroma bloom. 2^52 configurations. CHAOS stacks modules, MUTATE auto-cycles recipes, bass/mid/treble drive corruption. Linear HDR out.

description: Chrome Bloom — a floating liquid-metal splash sculpture. Raymarched metaballs stretch into thin spiky tendrils with droplet tips, every surface a perfect mirror of a procedural sky: editable zenith blue overhead, pale horizon light, and a warm gold sheen pooling only in the downward reflections.
title: Chrome Bloom

description: Mirror Shards — four thin mirror-finish planes intersect and tumble slowly in a clean off-white void. Each face carries flowing acid-marble paint: domain-warped ink in saturated magenta, cyan, yellow, orange and violet with white veins, so the marbling itself is the color while the void stays empty.
title: Mirror Shards

description: Painted Orbit — a surrealist airbrushed still life. One large glossy amber orb hangs mid-canvas while sweeping black, cream and sage-green blades arc over and around it, small satellite pebbles drift nearby and a thin wire line loops through the arrangement — all over a soft sky-blue to cream ver...
title: Painted Orbit

description: Ribbon Falls — dozens of stacked paper-cut wave layers cascading down the sheet in three tiers, each layer a flat curated ink (cobalt, powder blue, leaf green, vermillion, wine, pinks, cream, gold) with scalloped finger-lobes on its edge and a soft ambient-occlusion shadow under every lip. Pale g...
title: Ribbon Falls

description: Squiggle Loop — a thick round tube meandering and self-crossing over pale ice-blue paper, changing ink at every bend: solid, striped and speckled segments in curated saturated inks (cobalt, orange-red, teal, yellow, violet, pink, green, black). Proper over/under crossings with painterly contact s...
title: Squiggle Loop

description: Cosmic Splash — a 1970s airbrush sci-fi poster: deep black void crossed diagonally by great sweeping comet streaks in cream, pink, cobalt and yellow with feathered airbrush edges, fine dot-spray speckle clusters along them, and one bold red circle accent sitting in its own dark halo. A persistent...
title: Cosmic Splash

description: Aura Field — a radiant aura poster. A layered radial glow breathes from white through gold and hot pink into magenta, framed by a muted grey-mauve border under heavy fine film grain.
title: Aura Field

description: Sphere Swarm — an Unreal-Niagara-style particle formation: a hundred small rounded gradient cards distributed on an invisible fibonacci sphere, perspective-projected onto a clean white void, slowly revolving. Near cards read large and crisp, the far hemisphere shrinks and fades into the paper.
title: Sphere Swarm

description: Fog Grid — a dark technical plate: hairline blueprint grid panel floating on near-black, draped in a thick frosted gel fog lit from within by neon gradients (hot pink through molten orange to acid yellow-green on a diagonal). The gel is a domain-warped fbm volume with milky subsurface shading, wh...
title: Fog Grid

description: Lava Scribble — a warm grey canvas where neon coral lava flows organically as a slow domain-warped metaball field with chartreuse patches, a crisp pale halo outline, and dense black scribble-hatch clusters (layered rotated stripes broken by hash noise) filling the negative space and hugging the l...
title: Lava Scribble

description: Paint Cosmos — an ultra-elegant blurred nebula: big out-of-focus fog patches of teal, crimson, violet and amber with a dark vignette pooling center-right and fine film grain. Floating razor-sharp above it: a few small glossy 3D-shaded spheres with specular dots and soft shadows, thin tube-shaded ...
title: Paint Cosmos

description: Frozen Flock — a liquid boid swarm whose consensus crystallizes: aligned neighbors snap to lattice facets, glowing bonds grow between them and the flock freezes into an angular marching crystal; a beat shatters the lattice (bonds flash white, particles scatter), then it re-anneals between hits. Crystalline Flow x Linear fusion; black background always.
title: Frozen Flock

description: Silver Current — monochrome flow-field of thousands of hair-fine comet streaks riding curl-noise currents over black, converging into a luminous congestion band; bass surges the current, mids bend the field, highs sparkle the comet heads. Analytic streamline rendering, long-exposure wind-trail finish.
title: Silver Current

description: Strata Waves — stacked laminated-paper strata of sliced-outline ribbon topography surging in big smooth plateau waves; vivid per-stratum palette with repeated lighter outline copies and paper shadows on light gray. Bass swells the amplitude, mids roll the wave clock, highs brighten the rims.
title: Strata Waves

description: Airbrush Bloom — an airbrush pinwheel flower of soft-3D capsule petals (hot pink rim, red core, blue/mint pools) breathing on warm paper white; bass pumps the bloom, mids wind the spiral, highs sweep satin sheens, beats pulse a full bloom.
title: Airbrush Bloom

description: Thorn Chrome — raymarched liquid-chrome thorn stars: twin metaball cores with long needle spikes drifting on a blue-sky gradient, mirror-chrome shading with pink iridescence and star glints at the spike tips; bass extends the thorns, mids rock the clusters, highs fire glints, beats flash lens sparkles.
title: Thorn Chrome

description: A generative musical score painting itself: warm-white paper, faint staff groups, Miro-primary note dots stamped on a rhythmic grid and joined into phrases by beams, stems and slur arcs. A living subset of dots hops between adjacent staff lines with eased leaps and every dot drifts along its line — mids and beats wind the hop clock so the music visibly flows through the score; beats stamp new notes, bass swells the freshest marks, mids sweep a playhead shimmer.
title: Note Field

description: Patchbay — a modular-synth patchbay poster: warm panel, grid of concentric jack sockets, thick drooping catenary patch cables in red/orange/blue/yellow/gray with drop shadows and round plug heads; beats re-patch one cable on eased swinging arcs, bass sags and bounces every cable, mids run traveling pulses along the cords, highs glint the plugs.
title: Patchbay

description: Milk Light — a bright milky pearl fog fills the frame while dozens of out-of-focus colored light points (green, amber, magenta, cyan, violet) drip slow beaded light-trails downward like luminous rain behind frosted glass; level swells the inner glow, bass breathes the fog, mids lengthen the drips, highs pop sparkles that blur away.
title: Milk Light

description: Soft Circuit — an interlocking maze of rounded airbrush-glow pipe tubes (red, blue, green, yellow, pink neon-pastel on warm paper) that continuously reroutes: quarter-turn truchet tiles flip in eased waves from hashed epicenters; beats speed the flip waves, bass thickens the glow, mids cycle hues along the paths, highs whiten the cores.
title: Soft Circuit

description: Electricity — the Earth–ionosphere cavity as a living instrument: five Schumann resonance shells (7.83 Hz + harmonics, each fed by its own FFT band) undulate as hairline standing waves over the planet's curve; thunder filaments strike on a hashed, beat-advanced schedule and every strike ripples the earth for seconds. Bass swells the ground waves, mids turbulate filament wander, highs crackle strike-point sparks.
title: Electricity

description: Autonomous — a shader that runs its own AV show: six embedded scenes (neon tunnel, plasma ocean, warp starfield, kaleido bloom, synthwave grid, aurora curtains) shuffle on a slow hashed schedule. Song intensity accelerates scene changes, buildups widen the transition window, beat drops slam transitions through with a glitch-flash cut. Transition style selectable (crossfade / wavy wipe / zoom punch / glitch slice) or auto-shuffled; universal params for show speed, transition length, hue, brightness, audio reactivity.
title: Autonomous

description: PP — it's raining PPs: an endless downpour of tumbling neon 3D replicas of the pp.glb model, each with its own hashed color, size, and expansion; a hashed ~40% are audio reactive (bass-inflated, beat-flashed, spin-kicked) while the rest fall serenely. Mids and level pour the rain faster; silence leaves a slow, elegant, faintly absurd drizzle.
title: PP

description: Orby — a dreamy airbrushed orb whose skin is a living reaction-diffusion-style blob field. Soft pastel candy blobs bloom, drift and dissolve across a raymarched sphere on a periwinkle sky, wrapped in a huge hazy halo with counter-rotating rings of bokeh lights and film grain. Bass breathes the orb's relief, mids feed the field, beats splat new blobs in and pulse the halo and bokeh.
title: Orby

description: Shapes and Gradients — an airbrushed retro poster brought to life: a grainy sunset sky from slate blue down to hot yellow, two pink twelve-point starbursts with glowing orange cores over violet halos, a tall olive cone rising through the middle, and a bottom band of pinstripe panels, a lavender strip with yellow lights, a radiant orange blob, and wandering liquid-chrome squiggles. Beats flash the star cores and stretch the spikes, bass swells the orange blob and halos, mids ripple the chrome, highs sparkle the grain.
title: Shapes and Gradients

description: Flowa — a spinning garden of iridescent blooms on royal blue, no stems: the hero flower slowly rotates, its petal layers counter-rotating and unfurling in a breathing bloom cycle, rims bursting into thin-film rainbows combed with fiber striations. Four satellite flowers of different abstract anatomy — rounded, spiked, a carved ring bloom, a small six-lobe — drift around it with the same chromatic auras. Bass breathes the blooms, mids ripple the edges, highs shimmer the iridescence, beats flash the hearts.
title: Flowa

description: Butaflies — a luminous swarm of butterflies drifting through a hazy pastel-blue sky. Two dozen glowing white butterflies at different depths — big soft ones up close, tiny bright sparks far away — orbit and wander around a slowly roaming swarm heart, each flapping at its own rhythm, melting into the haze with distance. Bass breathes the swarm wide, mids stir the wandering, beats kick the wingbeats and flash a hashed subset, highs sparkle the sky grain.
title: Butaflies

description: Octa Strings — a neon octagon instrument in a living tunnel: volumetric tube rings (bright rim, dark core) recede past textured octagonal walls with crisp flying rulings, corner rails and glitter in the light cone, while the camera sways off-axis. Eight harp strings play the spectrum — bass low, mids center, highs top — with plucked-string harmonic overtones and specular hot-spots riding the traveling wave, mirrored in a smeared reflective floor. Dust motes drift through the light; beats send a pulse ring down the tunnel.
title: Octa Strings

description: Sakura Dots — a wall of glossy 3D candy dots breathing color from the inside out: a hex grid of shaded spheres carries a radial bloom from a deep wine core through hot pink to porcelain edges, while a slow color wave rolls outward. Bass swells the dark heart, beats send a bright ripple ring through the dot sizes, highs sparkle the gloss.
title: Sakura Dots

description: Knot Candy — a real raymarched 3D knot of glossy candy tubes floating in the void: three intertwined strands twist around a shared ring like taffy, skinned in a flowing rainbow gradient with soft studio lighting and fresnel rim on pure black. Bass inflates the tubes, mids spin the twist, beats roll the rainbow around the surface, highs tighten the sparkle.
title: Knot Candy

description: Tangle — a living poster of six fat colored ropes hopelessly knotted over warm paper, each wandering its own looping path in classic poster inks, endlessly re-tangling in slow motion. Beats snap a kink through the ropes, bass thickens them, mids stir the wander.
title: Tangle

description: Candy Contours — a hypnotic topographic map of candy: dozens of concentric multicolor stripe rings wrapped around a tilted, elongated, wobbling core, every ring its own hashed vivid ink, all flowing endlessly toward the center. Bass squeezes the form, mids wobble the silhouette, beats hue-shift the ring deck.
title: Candy Contours

description: Holo Marble — holographic ink marbling on warm cream: saturated pastel rivers engraved with fine topographic micro-contours, deep navy tendrils cutting the flow, soft white gleams riding the currents. Mids deepen the warp, beats sweep a gleam across the sheet, bass swells the rivers, highs sharpen the engraving.
title: Holo Marble

description: Ripple Pool — grainy interference rings on risograph paper: three slow-orbiting drop points collide into moiré blooms tinted tangerine, ultraviolet and cerulean, dissolved in heavy print grain. Beats drop a fresh splash, bass stretches the wavelength, mids swirl the sources, highs boil the grain.
title: Ripple Pool

description: Vinyl Pour — glossy superflat paint in slow motion: fat blobs of red, cobalt, yellow, pink and cream pour and merge across a gray studio wall, dead-flat with dark meniscus outlines and wet vinyl highlights. Bass fattens the pour, beats wobble the puddles, mids speed the drift, level polishes the gloss.
title: Vinyl Pour

description: Night Bouquet — abstract luminous flower-forms unfurling out of deep black: domain-warped spiral blooms that only suggest petals, painted as silk-ink gradients flowing rose into coral into cream into leaf green into iris violet, with crisp filaments and fine luminous threads over soft back-plumes, all slowly breathing like ink in water. Bass pushes the unfurl, mids sway the forms, beats breathe a luminous ring out of each bloom, highs light the threads.
title: Night Bouquet

description: Meadow Dream — a dimensional dusk landscape the camera drifts through: five parallax mountain ridgelines dissolving into lilac haze under a slowly shifting gradient sky with drifting cloud decks and a haloed low sun, over a real blade-by-blade grass foreground swaying in layered wind, tips backlit gold, petaled wildflowers riding the tallest stems. Bass breathes the halo, mids push wind through the grass, beats send a golden shimmer across the blade tips.
title: Meadow Dream

description: A radial fire orb: a slowly-morphing sphere of living flame floating in darkness — turbulent fire wrapped around a blinding white heart like a miniature sun, licking radial tendrils breathing in and out, embers spiraling off the surface, heat shimmer bending the dark around it. Bass roars the orb bigger, beats burst embers, mids flicker the tendrils, level stokes the star.
title: Element Fire

description: Real living water: slow heavy swells of superposed wandering waves, fluid caustic light webs with fine detail octaves, streaky foam lacing the crests with drifting foam speckle, lazy vortex swirls around drifting centers, and light shafts slanting through deep teal into abyssal navy. Bass swells the current, mids ripple the caustics, beats fizz the foam, highs glint the crests.
title: Element Water

description: Element Air — the invisible made visible: ribbons of wind combing a high pale sky in silver streamlines, dandelion seeds and leaves tumbling through the currents, cloud shoals dissolving along the gusts. Mids gust the streamlines, bass leans the whole wind, beats loose a scatter of seeds.
title: Element Air

description: Element Aether — the fifth element: a violet-teal nebula folding through the void around a radiant quintessence orb, ringed by a tilted orbit of sigil-stars over a three-depth twinkling starfield. Bass breathes the orb, beats flare the sigils in sequence, mids fold the nebula, highs twinkle the deep field.
title: Element Aether

description: Chrome Cypher — liquid metal behind hierarchically shattered glass: a few huge voronoi panes break into fine shard clusters, each pane a sheet of glass at its own depth with parallax drift. The shared molten-chrome field reflects a real studio environment — horizon gradient, hot filament, rotating softboxes, neon bounce — with sharp fresnel edges. Seams are live circuitry: pulses run along them and flare white at junction nodes; dark panes run data rain. Bass swells the chrome, mids pour it faster, highs spark the traces, beats nudge the panes.
title: Chrome Cypher

description: Kusama Dots — an infinity polka-dot field in Yayoi Kusama's palettes: crisp red dots breathing across warm white, or her black-on-yellow and yellow-on-black nets. The field warps like fabric, dot sizes flow in traveling bands, scattered dots jitter off the grid — and inside a roaming obliteration lens the dots inflate into glossy 3D spheres with real contact shadows before melting flat again. Bass swells the dot waves, mids pour the warp, beats grow the lens and ripple the net, highs sparkle the micro-dots.
title: Kusama Dots

description: La B Clouds — a golden-hour dusk cloudscape with real volume: self-shadowed cloud banks in deep rose, terracotta and plum rolling slowly across a saturated gradient sky, gold-lined edges facing a low sun, and warm god-ray shafts breaking through the gaps. Bass swells the cloud mass, mids pour the drift, beats send a soft gleam through the sun and shafts.
title: La B Clouds

description: La B Silk — liquid silk with dimension: a deeply folded fabric height-field pouring in slow continuous motion under a dramatic key light — bordeaux shadow valleys, champagne satin ridge highlights, midnight-blue accents pooling in select folds, and a fine woven-thread micro-texture glinting in the light. Bass deepens the folds, mids push the pour, beats sweep a gleam across the ridges, highs shimmer the weave.
title: La B Silk

description: La B Petals — silk petals in deep blush, wine and ivory tumbling slowly through dark space on a charcoal-plum gradient. Six parallax depth layers with true depth-of-field: near petals bloom large and soft, the focus band renders crisp satin shading with bright rims and a center crease, far petals recede small and dim. Bass sways the fall, mids push the flutter, beats gleam the rims, highs sparkle dust motes.
title: La B Petals

description: Audio-reactive exploding cube grid — 276 cubes with beat detection, bass pump, and scatter physics
title: Cube Explosion

title: Fluid+3D (Phase2)

title: ISF+3D (POC)

title: Particles

title: Pretext

title: Tesseract
